svg.text: UML component diagram · Closet v1.5 (Milestone 2 final)
Modular monolith. React UI → API Gateway → Authentication + Security → feature modules → repositories → PostgreSQL. Adapters connect external services. Solid = request flow, dashed = «use».
One source of truth: item status lives only in Availability; every
screen, the planner monitor and the engine read it — never a copy.
Status rules reach the web app through GET /vocabulary.
